teaching_hospitals_and_federal_facilitie.note: Facility-level contacts vary; verify per hospital/agency listing before routing.

private_hospitals.note: Use state health facility regulator/association directories; avoid guessing contacts.

pharmaceuticals_and_distributors.note: For fake drugs/unsafe products, route to NAFDAC first.

complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_1: Complain to the hospital/clinic (medical director/complaints desk) in writing; request a response and patient record audit trail.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_2: If professional misconduct: escalate to the relevant professional council (MDCN/PCN/NMCN etc.) with evidence.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_3: If counterfeit/unsafe drugs/foods: escalate to NAFDAC with product details, batch numbers, receipts, and photos.
complaint_and_escalation_flow.step_4: If insurance/HMO denial: escalate to NHIA (and copy the HMO/provider).
